name: Unmei no Hito.
source:
One day, the main character, a first-year high school student, is told by a fortune teller he met in the city that "the person who has been kind to you recently is your destined partner."

The person that comes to mind is Himeda Narumi, her senior who used to carry cardboard boxes with her.

She confesses to him right away, but...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7015]NovelGame[/url]]
